task: Find all startup companies from the 2022 and 2023 Y Combinator batches that are based in France and currently have job openings.
agent_final_answer:
The startup companies from the 2022 and 2023 Y Combinator batches that are based in France and currently have job openings are:

1. **HyLight**
   - **Batch**: Summer 2023
   - **Location**: Paris, Île-de-France, France
   - **Description**: Unmanned airships for inspecting critical assets
   - **Job Openings**: 9 openings (including Embedded Software Engineer, Senior GNC Engineer, Electronics Engineer, Quality Manager, Production Manager)
   - **Profile**: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/hylight

2. **Windmill**
   - **Batch**: Summer 2022
   - **Location**: Paris, Île-de-France, France
   - **Description**: Open-source platform to turn scripts into internal apps & workflows
   - **Job Openings**: 4 openings (Distributed Systems Engineer, Founding SDR, DevTool Growth Lead, Product Software Engineer)
   - **Profile**: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/windmill

3. **Osium AI**
   - **Batch**: Summer 2023
   - **Location**: Paris, Île-de-France, France
   - **Description**: Speed up materials innovation with Artificial Intelligence
   - **Job Openings**: 3 openings (Full-stack engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist)
   - **Profile**: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/osium-ai

4. **Escape**
   - **Batch**: Winter 2023
   - **Location**: Paris, Île-de-France, France
   - **Description**: Offensive security for teams that are 100x outnumbered
   - **Job Openings**: 2 openings (Head of Sales, Product Marketing Manager)
   - **Profile**: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/escape

5. **Rimward**
   - **Batch**: Summer 2023
   - **Location**: Paris, Île-de-France, France
   - **Description**: Solar farm security software for existing cameras
   - **Job Openings**: 2 openings (Security / IoT Deployment Engineer, Platform Engineer)
   - **Profile**: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/rimward

6. **Twenty**
   - **Batch**: Summer 2023
   - **Location**: Paris, Île-de-France, France
   - **Description**: Open Source CRM
   - **Job Openings**: 2 openings (Junior Product Designer - Internship Paris, Product Designer)
   - **Profile**: https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/twenty
